outcome.known_limitations: All indicator data comes from the shell's own freedesktop notification server: when ConfigService.notificationsEnabled is false (the default) the shell runs no server and shows NO notification badges - honest degradation, Plasma's daemon owns the data instead. KWin window-attention (demandsAttention) indicators are SCOPED OUT as blocked-on-bridge: the resident KWin event bridge does not forward demandsAttention, its compiled plugin is not built in this checkout and the bridge is Intellihide-gated. expireTimeout -1/0 notifications persist until the user attends (dismisses the toast, invokes an action or activates the app's dock icon) - a deliberate, documented server default rather than an estimate. Apps stacks aggregate count+critical but never progress (one merged ring value would be arbitrary). Not verified on live hardware (offscreen E2E only): visual composition of ring/dot/badge, magnification interplay and real multi-monitor stacking remain manual test debt (live_verified false).
